# @cosmjs/utils Agent Guide

> **Package**: `@cosmjs/utils` v0.38.0 **Purpose**: Utility functions for
> testing and assertions **Layer**: Foundation Layer (no CosmJS dependencies)

## Package Overview

Provides utility functions primarily for testing, including assertions, sleep,
and type guards.

## Key Exports

| Export                                 | Purpose                            |
| -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `assert(condition, msg?)`              | Assertion with error message       |
| `assertDefined(value, msg?)`           | Assert value is not null/undefined |
| `assertDefinedAndNotNull(value, msg?)` | Stricter assertion                 |
| `sleep(ms)`                            | Async sleep/delay                  |
| `isDefined(value)`                     | Type guard for defined values      |
| `isNonNullObject(value)`               | Type guard for objects             |

## Common Usage

```typescript
import { assert, assertDefined, sleep, isDefined } from "@cosmjs/utils";

// Assertions
assert(value > 0, "Value must be positive");
assertDefined(account, "Account not found");

// Sleep
await sleep(1000); // Wait 1 second

// Type guards
if (isDefined(optional)) {
  // TypeScript knows optional is not undefined here
  console.log(optional.property);
}

// Object checks
if (isNonNullObject(value)) {
  // value is Record<string, any>
}
```

## Usage in Tests

```typescript
import { assert, sleep } from "@cosmjs/utils";

it("waits for transaction", async () => {
  await client.broadcastTx(tx);
  await sleep(1000); // Wait for block

  const result = await client.getTx(txHash);
  assert(result !== null, "Transaction not found");
});
```
